title: herald event
description: One event as an app writes it.

attributes.description:
Its kind's attributes, by name: a versioned kind's `version`, and
`prerelease`.

id.description:
The app's own id for the event, which no other event of the app has.
Any text: a request reading its standing back writes it as one path
segment, percent-encoded.

kind.description:
What kind of thing it announces: one herald ships or one the config
declares; `message` where it is left out.

links.description:
Named links, each an `https` or `http` URL: `release`, `changelog`,
`comparison`, `download`.

occurred.description:
When it happened, in RFC 3339; when herald read it where it is left
out.

origin.description:
Where it comes from: the forge or registry, the owner, and the
repository or package, which a route's `match` reads; none where it
is left out.

Attribute.description: One of an event's attributes, as its kind defines them.

Kind.description: What kind of thing an event announces: release, package-version, feed-entry, message, run, or a kind the config declares.

Origin.description:
Where an event comes from: the forge or registry, the owner and the
repository or package, with what the source knows of it.

forge.description:
The forge or registry, as a source's `kind` names it, such as
`github` or `npm`.

host.description: Its host, with a port where it is not the scheme's own.

id.description: The forge's or registry's stable id for it.

owner.description:
The owner: an account, organization or group path, or a registry's
scope, vendor or namespace; empty where the package has none.

properties.description: Its custom properties, each with the values it holds.

repository.description: The repository's full path, or the package's name.

oneOf.description: Members of the forge's enterprise or instance.
